finding: Inherited base.command has no encompassing finally. An exception after Popen, including its post-spawn receipt save or wait4/group observation, can leave custody unresolved. Frozen v2 uses only an exception-message substring to decide scratch removal.
correction: Record pending before every inherited command call. Clear only after typed terminal child-reap and exact owned-group-absence proof. Every unproven exception or malformed return retains scratch, stops further commands/attempts and records unresolved command custody independently of exception text.
scope: small source-only exception-path preservation; no VM, telemetry or general runner rewrite
runtimeEffect: None executed. Prior ordinary-exit v1 results remain valid. No old primary rerun or native/local-custody probe is selected.
